108c136450a87b0f28c35d72fbf942d9f6cf5c40.rationale: The presence of bilateral vestibular schwannomas, a parasellar mass consistent with a meningioma, and a cervical extramedullary lesion on brain MRI are characteristic of Neurofibromatosis Type 2.

Neurofibromatosis Type 2: F4: Known plexiform neurofibroma of the arm confirmed by biopsy 1 year earlier
F21: Bilateral vestibular schwannomas on brain MRI with and without contrast
F22: Parasellar mass consistent with a meningioma on brain MRI with and without contrast
F23: Cervical extramedullary lesion on brain MRI with and without contrast
